title: Click a cut and pick a transition from tiles
goal: Picking a transition today is a list of radio buttons with paragraphs in the side panel. Clicking a cut should open a small picker right at the cut with thumbnail tiles, as the mock draws it, with type and length as simple rows in the panel.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The transition picker is a radio list with paragraphs in the panel (TransitionInspector.swift). The mock (comp-video.html section 06, video-transitions.html) puts an AT THIS CUT popover on the edit point with thumbnail tiles, and the panel shows tidy Edit point and Transition rows with Type and Length dropdowns. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Clicking an edit point opens the popover with animated thumbnail tiles: Cross dissolve, Dip to black, Dip to white, Push, Wipe, Blur through, each saying whether it needs overlap
Properties shows Edit point (Outgoing, Incoming, Spare before/after) and Transition (Type and Length dropdowns) as label/value rows, no paragraphs
A transition drawn on the cut in the timeline can be lengthened by dragging its edges
Works between two different clips, not only pieces of one

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

video-shell.html was deleted on 2026-09-23 (task the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is): it was the loop's own study arguing against tracks. The target is now pages/video.html, the video-*.html walkthroughs and comp-video.html, restored as the user drew them, plus UX-PATTERNS D18 (rewritten: a document with time has tracks). Where this task mentions video-shell, read video.html.

pre-build review: (1) Transitions exist today only on joins INSIDE one clip (pieces), stored on the arriving piece; the first piece of a clip deliberately drops any arrival, so a cut BETWEEN two clips (two layers butted on a track, which the second-clip task made real) needs its own home: the incoming clip carries how it arrives. (2) Only three kinds exist (dissolve, dip black/white); the mock's picker has six (adds Push, Wipe, Blur through, all needing overlap), so the renderer needs those three: push and wipe done with crop+frame so nothing spills outside the clip's frame, blur through as a dissolve with a blur peaking at the cut. (3) A Premiere editor clicks a cut, gets the transition on it, and sees it in Effect Controls; here clicking an edit point opens the AT THIS CUT picker right at the cut (native popover, walks can press inside popovers), and the panel shows Edit point + Transition as label/value rows with Type and Length dropdowns, as video-transition-wt.html draws. (4) Band edges drag the length, as the within-clip band already does; the between-clip band is new. (5) Mock rows I will NOT build here: 'The overlap sits before/across/after' and 'Hold on black' (inserting real black moves clips). Neither is in acceptance; will search the queue and file/fold. (6) Risk: an overwrite drop that splits a clip into two layers must not copy the arrival transition onto the second half.

side by side with the mock (video-transition-wt.html #transPick, #propsCut; comp-video.html 03): picker header, spare line, 2x3 tiles with needs overlap / no overlap / no spare match; tiles PLAY rather than the mock's still gradients (acceptance asked for animated); the mock's closing explanation line left out (labels, not explanations); Properties Edit point grid2 fields and Transition Type/Length dropdowns + Paid with match. Differences filed as a-transition-can-sit-before-across-or-after-the: The overlap sits row, Hold on black row, dashed spare strips. left rough (no task): sound cuts hard at an edit point with a transition; clicking a join the playhead stands on hits the playhead; the dock's right edge clips the dropdown chevrons and value boxes (pre-existing, the Reframe numbers clip the same way).

Clicking an edit point between two clips, or a join inside one, opens an At this cut picker with six playing tiles (dissolve, dip black/white, push, wipe, blur through) saying needs overlap / no overlap / no spare; a picked cut's Properties shows Edit point (Out, In, Spare after/before) and Transition (Type and Length dropdowns, Paid with) as label/value rows; the band over the cut drags its length; works between two different clips (Layer.arrivalTransition, EditPointTransitions.swift).
